description: Platinum Database sells two types of subscription software packages: a personal license and a commercial license which will cost $550 and $2000 to generate respectively. The marketing department estimates that they can sell at most 300 licenses for both versions combined a month. The profit per personal license is $450 and the profit per commercial version is $1200. If the company does not want to spend more than $400000, how many of each software package should they produce to maximize the profits.

CostPersonalLicense.definition: Cost to generate a personal license

CostCommercialLicense.definition: Cost to generate a commercial license

MaxTotalLicenses.definition: Maximum total licenses that can be sold per month

MaxTotalExpenditure.definition: Maximum total expenditure allowed by the company

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing and selling personal and commercial software licenses"

constraints.description: The total number of personal and commercial licenses produced per month should not exceed MaxTotalLicenses
The total expenditure on generating personal and commercial licenses should not exceed MaxTotalExpenditure
The number of personal and commercial licenses produced should be non-negative

PersonalLicenses.definition: Number of personal licenses produced per month

CommercialLicenses.definition: Number of commercial licenses produced per month
